title: Rockstar Reveals £350 GTA 6 Collectibles Box Without The Game
description: Rockstar Games has announced the limited Goodtime State Vice City collection for GTA6 priced at £349, which notably excludes the game itself. Read more for details.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Rockstar Reveals £350 GTA 6 Collectibles Box Without The Game

As anticipation for Grand Theft Auto 6 continues to build worldwide, Rockstar Games has rolled out a brand-new, highly limited merchandise collection that is already turning heads. According to a recent report by Eurogamer, the studio has announced the "Goodtime State Vice City" collection—a box of themed goodies priced at a staggering £349, which is available for pre-order now.

### What to Expect from the Vice City Collection

Tailored specifically for die-hard fans of the upcoming franchise entry, the Goodtime State Vice City collection is packed with a variety of naughty and themed collectibles. According to the media description, the box contains unique items that capture the chaotic essence of the game's setting, with some commentators humorously noting that certain contents are items you definitely wouldn't get through airport security.

However, the most notable and controversial detail surrounding this expensive bundle is its price tag and composition. Despite costing £349, the collection **does not include a copy of the game itself**. Buyers looking to dive into the virtual world of GTA 6 will still need to purchase the software separately.

### Context and Market Strategy

High-end collector's editions have long been a staple of major AAA game rollouts, allowing developers to monetize their most dedicated fanbases through physical memorabilia. By offering a standalone collector's box rather than a traditional bundled collector's edition, Rockstar is leaning heavily into the pure merchandise market. While this approach allows for more unique physical items, the separate purchase requirement may deter some players who expect a bundled discount.

Pre-orders for the £349 collection are live now, and it remains to be seen how quickly these exclusive items will be snapped up by eager fans looking to secure a piece of Vice City history ahead of the game's launch.

### Editor's Take

Rockstar's £350 price tag for a merchandise box that excludes the actual game is a bold move that highlights the immense drawing power of the GTA brand. While the collection promises fun and exclusive memorabilia for hardcore enthusiasts, the lack of the game itself means only the most devoted collectors will find true value here. Budget wisely before pulling the trigger.
